column1: # Every Claude Code skill on Karol's Mac Studio: the one place each skill lives and whether it is in use.
# install.sh links every "active" row into ~/.claude/skills; Atlas (Skille) and Tandem's knowledge base read this file too.
# Columns, separated by one tab: name, status (active | retired), folder (relative to ~/Projects), note.
# A skill has exactly one active row: that folder is its source of truth; edit the skill there and nowhere else.
